name: inframap-f02f224c-blind17-ots
instr:
# inframap draws the wrong infrastructure diagrams — repairing it without a test suite

I point this tool at a description of infrastructure I already run and it draws me a picture of what talks to what. It is now wrong in a great many places at once, although nothing about my inputs changed. The repository has received 17 separate undocumented edits. What follows is everything I could pin down by running the tool and by calling into it from my own small programs.

Choosing how the picture comes out answers backwards. Naming the output form the tool does support fails and hands me nothing, and naming a form nobody supports, such as "potato", no longer comes back as an unknown-format complaint.

Handing it a saved snapshot of what is already deployed misbehaves once per cloud, so each cloud is its own separate breakage. From the cloud whose entries are load balancers, launch templates, machines, databases and caches, some entries go missing and others end up joined in ways their stated dependencies do not justify, and a snapshot in which one entry carries no identifier is no longer refused with the missing-identifier complaint it used to raise. From the cloud that writes rule direction in capitals, a snapshot describing two machines joined by one firewall rule does not yield the two boxes and the single link between them at all, and neither does the same infrastructure written out by hand, so that cloud is unusable either way.
